criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Use a compatible locally available React Router package, record version/import package, and wrap the app in BrowserRouter. Show the initial route renders. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement /products and /products/:id pages. Read the ID parameter and display the matching local product; distinguish unknown ID from loading. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use router links from list cards to details. Demonstrate navigation and browser Back/Forward while preserving coherent page content. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Show an accessible NotFound page for /unknown with a link back to products. Explain how unknown UI routes differ from API 404 responses. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Store a search/filter value in query parameters. Copy the URL into a new tab and show the same filter is restored. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Redirect signed-out users away from a dashboard to login and return to the intended page after login. Demonstrate the API independently rejects unauthenticated access. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Open and refresh a detail URL directly. Configure or document the development/production fallback needed, ensuring /api/ requests are not replaced by HTML. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
